title: Reliability, high availability and fault tolerance

kcs.statement: Availability measures whether the system is up when asked; reliability measures whether it performs correctly over time, so a system can be up yet unreliable when it returns wrong results.

High availability minimises downtime by recovering quickly and accepts a brief blip during failover; fault tolerance keeps operating with no interruption through a failure, at higher cost through full redundancy.
